description: This PHP source file manages the Web UI for configuring Wi-Fi Protected Setup (WPS) on a wireless network device. It includes scripts for handling WPS enable/disable, PIN management, and connection protocols, along with embedded HTML for user interaction.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates a WPS PIN checksum to ensure it is correctly formatted and valid.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends the current WPS configuration to the server via AJAX for applying settings.
